purpose: Phase-7C shared aggregation framework registry (Part 1 - Section 2). Declares the aggregation METHODS available to every immune module and the DEFAULT method + bounds per aggregation target. No biological module implements its own aggregation - each declares a target here and calls the shared ImmuneAggregator. Availability, confidence, evidence, prediction, and contribution traceability are always preserved; unavailable inputs are never treated as zero. Deterministic (ordered contributor iteration).

bounded_multiplicative.description: product of (1 - w_i*v_i) style saturating combination, bounded

dominant_contributor.description: value of the largest weighted contribution

availability_aware_average.description: weighted average over AVAILABLE/PARTIALLY_AVAILABLE inputs only (Section-1 utility)

confidence_weighted_average.description: weighted average with per-input confidence folded into the weight

conflict_resolution.note: When modules produce competing effects (e.g. high CD8 activity + high checkpoint pressure), the aggregator records BOTH as contributions and resolves them through the declared method; a later module never silently overwrites an earlier result. Conflicts are recorded as warnings on the aggregation result.
conflict_resolution.conflict_flag_threshold_note: If opposing signed contributions each exceed this magnitude, a conflict warning is attached (schematic).

rules.registry_driven: Every aggregation method + target is declared here, never hardcoded in a biological module.
rules.availability_preserved: Aggregate availability is AVAILABLE only if all inputs are available, PARTIALLY_AVAILABLE if some, UNAVAILABLE if none.
rules.traceability_preserved: Every aggregate records which inputs contributed, their weights, and which were ignored (and why).
